# Config

> [!NOTE]
> Dollar sign emoji (💲) next to a setting's name indicates that this setting is available only in the <b>Yassa edition</b>

Config file is located at `LabAPI/configs/.../FairScpSelection/config.yml`

| Name                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Default value                                                                                   |
|-------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| debug                         | Displays hidden logs for debugging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | false                                                                                           |
| dummy_mode                    | Dummies will be able to participate in the selection of an SCP (to ensure that a dummy's preferences has right values, you must use the `spawnpreference` command on dummy)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | false                                                                                           |
| include_dummy_in_calculations | Dummies will be included in the player count calculation, which may affect the number of SCPs required to spawn                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | false                                                                                           |
| lobby_interface               | Lobby Interface Settings                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | [See Here](#lobby-interface)                                                                    |
| reserved_scp_tickets          | SCP ticket reservation system settings                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | [See Here](#reserved-scp-tickets)                                                               |
| spawn_restrictions            | Role spawn restriction settings                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | [See Here](#spawn-restrictions)                                                                 |
| tickets_distribution          | SCP ticket distribution settings                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | [See Here](#tickets-distribution)                                                               |
| 💲 yassa_features             | Yassa features aka server specific settings                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | [See Here](#yassa-features)                                                                     |
| role_limitations              | Settings for the upper limits on the appearance of specific roles in a round for the SCP selection system. Note that the sum of all values in this configuration has no bearing on the total number of roles the server selects for any given round (that is determined by the number of players on the server and the value set via the `targetrolesnumber` command). <br/><br/>These settings can also be changed using the `rolelimitations` command (the settings will automatically revert to their config file state once the round restarts).<br/><br/>[See roles list here](ROLES.md)  | Scp049: 1<br/>Scp079: 1<br/>Scp096: 1<br/>Scp106: 1<br/>Scp173: 1<br/>Scp939: 1<br/>Scp3114: 1  |

> [!NOTE]
> If `Scp3114` is included in the `role_limitations` config and the `respect_roles_preferences` config is set to `true`, then `Scp3114` will not be able to spawn outside of the Halloween and Christmas event.

## Lobby Interface

| Name                             | Description                                                                                                                       | Default value |
| -------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |---------------|
| is_enabled                       | Enabled or not                                                                                                                    | true          |
| coroutine_delay                  | The delay time in seconds between the start of the cycle that checks SCP selection system data and the sending of hints to player | 1             |
| hint_duration                    | Hint display duration                                                                                                             | 2             |
| show_roles_teammates_whitelist   | Whitelist of roles that can see allies' roles in the hint                                                                         | []            |
| show_team_teammates_whitelist    | Whitelist of teams that can see allies' roles in the hint                                                                         | [ SCPs ]      |
| show_faction_teammates_whitelist | Whitelist of faction that can see allies' roles in the hint                                                                       | []            |

> [!NOTE]
> **Ally roles** are roles that have the same Faction

## Reserved SCP tickets

| Name               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Default value |
| ------------------ |----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| ------------- |
| is_enabled         | Enabled or not                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | true          |
| min_round_duration | The minimum round duration (in seconds) below which the SCP ticket reservation system will be active in the event of an early round end (the reservation system is always active in the event of an accidental round restart). Set the value to `0` to disable | 60            |

## Spawn Restrictions

| Name                          | Description                                                                             | Default value |
|-------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| ------------- |
| is_enabled                    | Enabled or not                                                                          | true          |
| prevent_non_scp               | Prevents spawn of non-SCP role                                                          | true          |
| prevent_zombies               | Prevents spawn of SCP-0492                                                              | true          |
| prevent_ai_loneliness         | Prevents spawn of SCP-079 if the server requires only 1 SCP                             | true          |
| prevent_shy_guy_loneliness    | Prevents spawn of SCP-096 if the server requires only 1 SCP                             | true          |
| prevent_worst_duo             | Prevents spawn of SCP-079 and SCP-096 together if the server requires only 2 SCP        | true          |
| respect_roles_preferences     | Prevents spawn of SCPs that cannot appear naturally in the game (for example, SCP-3114) | true          |

## Tickets Distribution

| Name                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Default value |
|------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| min_tickets            | Minimum number of SCP tickets                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | 10            |
| max_tickets            | Maximum number of SCP tickets                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | 32            |
| tickets_per_round      | The number of SCP tickets granted to a player who is not assigned the role of an SCP or any other role that might be issued by plugin                                                                                                                                                                                | 2             |
| max_storage_time       | The maximum time (in seconds) to retain data regarding the number of SCP tickets for a specific player in the `ScpTickets.txt file` (in other words, it removes SCP tickets for players who have not logged into the server for a long time). Set the value to `0` if you wish to disable the removal of SCP tickets | 1296000       |
| max_round_duration     | Determines up to which second after the start of a round tickets will be issued to players. Set the value to `0` to have tickets issued until the end of the round.                                                                                                                                                  | 0             |

## Yassa Features

> [!WARNING]
> Available only in the <b>Yassa edition</b>

| Name                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Default value |
|-------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| is_randomize_button_enabled   | Whether or not the button for randomizing spawn preferences is displayed                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | true        |
| roles_preference_sliders      | A list of roles for which spawn preference sliders are generated under the "Server-Specific" tab. If a spawn preference slider for a given role is also available in the "Other" settings tab, the preferences from the "Other" tab will take precedence (please keep this in mind regarding event-specific SCPs). The `Destroyed` role is excluded, as it is used to identify unavailable roles. [See roles list here](ROLES.md) | Scp3114     |

> [!NOTE]
> If you want specific roles (including SCP-3114) to spawn, don't forget to check the values for the `spawn_restrictions` and `role_limitations` settings.
